'''2000 Yavin 4 Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Yavin 4 region (D.C., Delaware, Kentucky, Maryland, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, West Virginia) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00yavin4">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=yavin4 2000 Regionals: Yavin 4], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010728173012/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=yavin4 Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Brian Rippetoe]] of Nolensville, Tennessee won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 8 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Quality Inn (Visible from I-75) Knoxville, Tennessee
